# Glenn J. White — Emeritus Professor of Astronomy

> Personal academic website of Glenn J. White: Emeritus Professor of Astronomy
> at The Open University, and previously Professor of Physics & Astronomy at
> Queen Mary College, University of London (1987–2000), Professor of Space
> Science at the University of Kent (2000–2005), Professor of Astronomy at The
> Open University (2005–2015) with a joint appointment as Research Group Leader
> at RAL Space, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory (2005–2015). His research covers
> star and planet formation, exoplanet transit searches, extragalactic surveys,
> far-infrared and submillimetre astronomy, space instrumentation and detectors,
> and artificial intelligence for astronomical analysis and discovery.

Contact: glenn.white@open.ac.uk · ORCID: 0000-0002-7126-691X

## Pages

- [Home](https://glenn-white.github.io/): introduction and latest news
- [About](https://glenn-white.github.io/about.html): biography, career timeline
  (Leicester 1986–87 → Queen Mary College 1987–2000 → Kent 2000–2005 → Open
  University 2005–2015 → Emeritus 2015–present) and visiting positions
  (Nobeyama Radio Observatory 1994, Stockholm Observatory 1998, Cavendish
  Laboratory 1999)
- [Research](https://glenn-white.github.io/research.html): research themes —
  star formation and the interstellar medium, exoplanets and stellar
  variability, extragalactic surveys, astronomical instrumentation, and AI/AGI
  in astronomy
- [Projects](https://glenn-white.github.io/projects.html): LOFAR, STEREO, ALMA,
  and past missions — Herschel-SPIRE, Planck HFI, AKARI, Darwin, SPICA
- [Publications](https://glenn-white.github.io/publications.html): 507
  publications (1975–2026), searchable and filterable
- [Machine-readable publication list](https://glenn-white.github.io/publications.json):
  the full publication record as JSON
- [Outreach](https://glenn-white.github.io/outreach.html): public talks, media
  and writing
- [Contact](https://glenn-white.github.io/contact.html): email, addresses and
  topics for media comment
